about: The AI assistants Kinetica connects itself to (editor/EditorOpsAssistants.cpp: assistant_list, assistant_connect, assistant_disconnect; «Файл → Подключить ИИ-ассистентов…»). A new assistant is a row: how it is found, how Kinetica's MCP server (tools/ke_editor_mcp.py) is written into it, how its being connected is seen. how: json - the server under mcpServers of its config file; cli - its own command adds and removes it. Words in braces: {home}, {appdata} (Windows), {config} (~/.config), {codex_home} (CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex), {python}, {server}, {port}, {plugins}; an argument whose {plugins} is empty is left out with the flag before it.
